bullet.purpose.title: what can it convert?
bullet.purpose.description: convert between common formats: video, audio, images, and documents. everything is re-encoded in your browser with ffmpeg, imagemagick, and pandoc.
bullet.privacy.title: on-device processing
bullet.privacy.description: files are converted locally with webassembly. nothing is uploaded, so even sensitive files stay on your device.
